defaults.summary: Meilisearch full-text search, one instance and key per group.

runtime.start:
: "${MEILI_MASTER_KEY:?this instance started without the key of its group}"
exec "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/meilisearch" --db-path "$STACK_DATA_DIR/data.ms" --dump-dir "$STACK_DATA_DIR/dumps" --snapshot-dir "$STACK_DATA_DIR/snapshots" --http-addr "127.0.0.1:$STACK_PORT" --env development --no-analytics
runtime.ready:
url="http://127.0.0.1:$STACK_PORT/health"
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsS -o /dev/null "$url"
else
  wget -q -O /dev/null "$url"
fi

notes.name: key
notes.text: The server starts with the group's key as its master key, read from its environment, and answers every route but /health only to a request carrying it as Authorization: Bearer; sites get it as MEILISEARCH_KEY and MEILI_MASTER_KEY.

notes.name: data_version
notes.text: Meilisearch opens only data its own release wrote and refuses to start on another's, so pin a version, and after changing it remove the instance's data directory and index the records again, as php artisan scout:import does for Laravel.

notes.name: listener
notes.text: It listens on 127.0.0.1 over HTTP only, with no Unix socket, and keeps its database, dumps and snapshots in the instance's data directory.

notes.name: group_rename
notes.text: A group rename does not carry its data: the index starts empty under the new name, so index the records again, as php artisan scout:import does for Laravel, and the old data directory stays until stack prune --data removes it.

recipes.title: Laravel Scout with Meilisearch
recipes.yaml:
group: shop
runtimes:
  php: "8.4"
services:
  - {name: search, type: meilisearch}
sites:
  - {name: app, type: laravel}
recipes.gives: Gives the site SCOUT_DRIVER=meilisearch, MEILISEARCH_HOST and MEILISEARCH_KEY, the same prefixed SEARCH_, such as SEARCH_MEILISEARCH_HOST, and APP_URL.

recipes.title: A search server for any client
recipes.gives: Gives MEILISEARCH_HOST, an http://127.0.0.1 URL, and MEILISEARCH_KEY, the key every request needs, pinned to 1.56 so the data stays readable.

services.description: Meilisearch 1.56, the newest release built for every platform
